name: northwind-holdout-v1
description: Held-out validation set written AFTER the abstention threshold was chosen on sample_qa.json and BEFORE any scores on it were observed. Mostly 'near-miss' unanswerable questions (the topic exists in the corpus but the requested fact does not), which are the hardest case for abstention.

items.question: What gloves must technicians wear inside a battery cabinet?
evidence: Technicians must wear insulated gloves rated to 1000 volts

items.question: What is the mileage reimbursement rate for using a personal car?
evidence: reimbursed at 0.58 US dollars per mile

items.question: How long do new starters have to sign up for health cover?
items.expected_answer: within 30 days of the start date
evidence: You must enrol in the health insurance plan within 30 days of your start date

items.question: After how long idle must a work laptop screen lock itself?
evidence: Screens must lock automatically after 5 minutes of inactivity
